data.title: Improve the layout feature for issues and make it more general purpose
data.description:
I want to update the Fleece issue graph layout engine so that it is general purpose and can be modified by external users of the library. This involves the following:

- Define an interface for the IGraphNode input into the algorithm. This should be implemented by the fleece issues that are currently processed by the issue graph service.
- Use a delegate to find the root nodes of the tree and an iterating delegate to then walk the tree and return the next node along with the relative position of the node. This would allow the tree construction to include filtering and both the tree mode and "next" mode in one service by just changing the delegates. This should perform a DFS by default and perform cycle checking.
- The result should be similar/identical to the current algorithm.
- It should also include edges and a matrix showing the assignment of "lanes" to edges that are extending from each node.

Refer to https://github.com/nick-boey/Homespun/blob/main/src/Homespun.Web/src/features/issues/services/task-graph-layout.ts. This takes in the (row, lane) layout that is currently generated by the Fleece.Core library and generates the edges and full graph layout. I would rather that this edge layout comes from the Fleece graph layout algorithm.

If there are are any patterns or architectures that you think would be beneficial for this application, let me know. I am happy to consider significant architectural changes. Ensure that the graph service (that generates the DAG of issues) is separate to the graph layout service (that generates a list of (issue, row, lane) coordinates and orthogonal edges connecting them).

This should then be used to replace the service that is currently used for the list --next and --tree commands.
